test-results.name: GlowRunner Smoke Test
test-results.notes: Verified via Unity MCP play mode: - Scene GlowRunner loads with 0 console errors - Player capsule auto-runs Z+ at 8 m/s - Space = jump (single + double confirmed) - Shift = dash (4m, 0.4s, invincibility, trail+particles) - Obstacles spawn (4 types: wall, gap, low-bar, spike) - HUD renders: Score, Best, Glow bar, Dash cooldown - Death → death screen → Space = restart - BGM plays on game start
